axis: putting a marker on a thing → setting a thing apart as worth notice

members.tone: The only member that raises its object rather than merely labelling it, conferring either conspicuousness or the status of being worth remark, where *mark* just designates.
The plain designating verb, working by figure as readily as by an actual mark and passing no judgement on what it singles out.
Literal where *mark* is figurative: the sign is cut into trees, so the word carries its instrument and nothing evaluative.
The whole force of the word sits in the marker it names, so it points a thing out without commenting on it.
Technical and flatly informative — what it puts on a thing is measurements, with none of the singling-out for notice that *distinguish* carries.
